mechanism: Both drugs possess anticholinergic properties; venlafaxine has mild anticholinergic effects and scopolamine is a potent anticholinergic agent, leading to additive anticholinergic toxicity and potential serotonin syndrome risk.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use lowest effective doses with close monitoring for anticholinergic symptoms (urinary retention, constipation, tachycardia, confusion) and CNS effects.
